overview.title: Your whole path on one screen
overview.body: Every requirement you have to meet, in one list, with where each one stands next to it. You never have to go looking for what is left.

order.title: Two ways to order the path
order.body: Defensible minimum puts the biggest risk and legal exposure first. Chronological follows the natural process, category by category.

filters.title: Narrow it to what needs you
filters.body: Filter the path down to what is open, overdue, due soon, or waiting on a sign-off.

legend.title: What the dots mean
legend.body: Every dot carries a state: now, in progress, awaiting sign-off, or signed off.

firstStep.title: Every row is one requirement
firstStep.body: Open a row to see what the requirement asks for and what to do about it. Start at the top and work down.

status.title: Where this requirement stands
status.body: The badge next to the title tracks the requirement from open through to signed off.

form.title: Answer the specifics
form.body: Edit records what your organisation actually does. Save keeps it, and your answers become part of the evidence.

evidence.title: Attach the proof
evidence.body: Upload the documents that show the measure is really running. That is what an audit asks for.

assign.title: Who is responsible
assign.body: Assign the person who owns this. It then shows up in their own list.

legal.title: What this rests on in law
legal.body: Every requirement names the article behind it: the NIS 2 article and the national transposition, in Germany the BSIG. The framework name links to the source text.

decide.title: Sign it off, or rule it out
decide.body: Once the requirement is met, sign it off. The sign-off is the record that management agreed. If it genuinely does not apply to you, mark it not applicable with a reason.

nav.title: Move through the path
nav.body: Back and next walk the requirements in order, without going via the overview.

sidebar.title: Everything else is on the left
sidebar.body: The path walks you through the work. The sidebar reaches the same content directly, plus your team, the settings, and the activity log.

registers.title: Your registers
registers.body: Assets, risks, incidents, suppliers, and the rest. The path fills these in as you go, and you can open any of them directly at any time.

help.title: Anything we can help with?
help.body: This is your second time here. If something is unclear or you are stuck, say so. You reach us directly.
help.selfHost: The code is open on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. You are free to run the platform on your own infrastructure whenever you want, and we answer questions about it.
help.training: Our management training course walks through all of this.
